links.outcome: Accuracy on hospital-document questions with no documents, fixed retrieval, interactive document access
links.effect: Mean accuracy 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval, 97.2% with interactive access (15.9 points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3)
links.quote: On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%).

unlisted_practices: On-premises deployment of open-weight LLM agent platform inside a closed hospital network
